method: Exact 2025 GEOID and LSAD join to the existing 2025 display geometries. LSAD 55 (comunidad), 57 (CDP), and 62 (zona urbana) are statistical places. An explicit (balance) qualifier in Census NAMELSAD identifies the partial balance of a city; it is not the full consolidated city. Remaining places are displayed as municipal place references; this is not a functional-status or government-identity determination.
limitations: Political and statistical geography overlap. Default detail shows municipal place and consolidated-city reference boundaries, not every kind of municipality: some towns and townships are county subdivisions, available as an optional additional layer. CDPs, balances and unresolved classifications are optional or shown when explicitly selected. No boundary is evidence of funding, activity, beneficiary location or financial allocation.
